blocker2aWhatsappNumberEnabledSplit.problem: v1.2 accounted the WhatsApp number (updateRestaurantWhatsapp) and enabled-state (updateRestaurantWhatsappEnabled) RPCs as ONE sub-write with one try/catch, even though they are two independent calls. Counterexample: number succeeds, enabled fails -> the sub-write is recorded as a single failure, the number's real persistence never advances any snapshot, the UI can show failure-only even though the number WAS persisted, and a retry needlessly resubmits the already-persisted number.
blocker2aWhatsappNumberEnabledSplit.fix: whatsappSubDirty/whatsappDirty replaced by whatsappNumberSubDirty/whatsappNumberDirty and whatsappEnabledSubDirty/whatsappEnabledDirty -- two independent dirty flags, two independent attemptedCount++/try/catch sites, two independent partial generalSnapshotRef advances (whatsapp field only on number success; whatsappEnabled field only on enabled success). Same two pre-existing RPCs, no RPC added/removed/merged.
blocker2aWhatsappNumberEnabledSplit.dependencyPreserved: CUSTOMER CONTACT v1's existing SQL contract (activating WhatsApp requires an already-valid persisted number) is kept, not dropped: the number sub-write is still gated by `whatsappNumberDirty && currentGeneral.whatsappEnabled` (never write the number while currently disabled); a new `whatsappEnabledBlockedByNumberDependency = currentGeneral.whatsappEnabled && whatsappNumberDirty && whatsappNumberFailedThisSubmit` blocks ONLY the enabled attempt, ONLY when activating, ONLY when the number was dirty and just failed in THIS SAME submit() -- so activation is never falsely reported as attempted/succeeded on top of a number that just failed, and it remains dirty for the very next Save once the number is actually persisted. Disabling never depends on the number (unchanged contract); an already-clean number never blocks activation.
blocker2aWhatsappNumberEnabledSplit.concurrencyProofAdded: W5 gives WhatsApp number X->Y-while-in-flight its own direct DOM/call-log proof (mirroring C3's mapsUrl proof) -- closes the re-audit's note that WhatsApp concurrency previously had only code-inspection evidence.

blocker2bTrackingTextPerStatusSplit.problem: setAllMerchantTrackingStatusText (lib/services/tracking-status-text.ts) loops CANONICAL_ORDER_STATUSES and awaits one RPC per status SEQUENTIALLY, aborting the whole loop (and the whole promise) on the first rejection -- so it was never one atomic write, even though v1/v1.1/v1.2 all used it as the save flow's single 'trackingText' sub-write. Counterexample: status #1 succeeds, status #2 fails -> #1 is persisted but the whole sub-write is recorded as failed, #1's snapshot never advances, a retry needlessly resubmits #1, and failure-only UI can hide the real partial persistence.
blocker2bTrackingTextPerStatusSplit.fix: A new trackingTextDirtyStatuses = CANONICAL_ORDER_STATUSES.filter(status => !generalSnap || trackingStatusDirty(generalSnap.statusTexts, currentGeneral.statusTexts, status)) is computed once per submit(), exactly like every other *Dirty flag. submit() then loops ONLY over that list, calling the pre-existing, UNMODIFIED unitary setMerchantTrackingStatusText(restaurantId, status, body) once per dirty status, each with its own attemptedCount++/try/catch/partial snapshot advance (generalSnapshotRef.current.statusTexts[status] only). Policy: CONTINUE (the mandate's own stated preference) -- one status's failure never skips or aborts later dirty statuses; every dirty status is always attempted and accounted for independently.
blocker2bTrackingTextPerStatusSplit.setAllMerchantTrackingStatusTextStatus: left completely unmodified in lib/services/tracking-status-text.ts ('may remain in the repository if other callers need it') -- it is simply no longer imported or called by app/dashboard/settings/page.tsx's save flow, which now imports and calls setMerchantTrackingStatusText directly. No SQL change, no DB transaction invented, no RPC added/removed/merged.
blocker2bTrackingTextPerStatusSplit.doNotUseSetAllAsAtomicityUnit: confirmed honored -- grep of app/dashboard/settings/page.tsx shows zero remaining `await setAllMerchantTrackingStatusText(` call sites (enforced by tests/cfte-v1-merchant-status-text-write.test.ts test '3.').

outcomeAccountingAndSnapshotInvariant.note: The pre-existing three-way outcome mechanism (succeededCount/failedKeys/attemptedCount -> stSaved / direct failure / stPartialSaveError-prefixed mixed) needed ZERO new code. Splitting one combined sub-write into two (WhatsApp) or up to seven (tracking text) independently-counted sites simply makes the SAME mechanism count the REAL underlying persistence units: number-succeeds+enabled-fails is now correctly 1 success + 1 failure (PARTIAL), never a false '0 successes' when one RPC had already persisted. The snapshot continues to mean 'known persisted state' -- only the exact field/status actually confirmed persisted (and, for enabled, only when not blocked by the number dependency) ever advances; everything else stays dirty.
